release_lines.text: Breaking Security Fix (`CVE-2024-35195`): Custom `TLSAdapter.get_connection_with_tls_context()` implementations in `v2.32.2` must include per-request `verify` in the connection pool key instead of reusing the first cached pool unconditionally.

Breaking Security Fix (`CVE-2024-37891`): `strip_sensitive_redirect_headers()` now strips `Proxy-Authorization` automatically across cross-host redirects unless `trust_env_redirects=True` is explicitly set.
Kept `idna>=2.5,<4` and `certifi>=2017.4.17` dependency bounds unchanged for Python `3.10+` installs.
Updated `Session.mount("https://", adapter)` docstrings to document connection-pool thread safety.

patch_diff_raw:
diff --git a/net_transport/adapters.py b/net_transport/adapters.py
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/net_transport/adapters.py
+++ b/net_transport/adapters.py
@@ -3,7 +3,7 @@
         self._pools = {}
 
     def get_connection_with_tls_context(self, host, verify=True):
-        pool_key = host
+        pool_key = (host, bool(verify))
         if pool_key not in self._pools:
             self._pools[pool_key] = {"host": host, "verify": bool(verify)}
         return self._pools[pool_key]
diff --git a/net_transport/redirects.py b/net_transport/redirects.py
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/net_transport/redirects.py
+++ b/net_transport/redirects.py
@@ -1,5 +1,6 @@
-def strip_sensitive_redirect_headers(headers, same_origin):
+def strip_sensitive_redirect_headers(headers, same_origin, trust_env_redirects=False):
     cleaned = dict(headers)
-    if not same_origin:
+    if not same_origin and not trust_env_redirects:
+        cleaned.pop("Proxy-Authorization", None)
         cleaned.pop("Authorization", None)
     return cleaned

acceptance_criteria: Must mark CVE-2024-35195 (verify pool key in get_connection_with_tls_context) and CVE-2024-37891 (Proxy-Authorization stripping across redirects) as breaking=true security changes grounded in RN-1 and RN-2.
Must trace TLSAdapter.get_connection_with_tls_context to clients/artifact_fetcher.py::download_release_tarball and strip_sensitive_redirect_headers to clients/mirror_sync.py::follow_mirror_redirect.
Must NOT mark RN-3 (unchanged idna/certifi dependency bounds) or RN-4 (docstring update) as breaking=true.
